title: Design System: Claude Builders Club @ Northeastern

display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page, capped near 16ch.

body.purpose: All prose, held to a 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase meta — dates, categories, field labels.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: The highlighter. The only motion in the system. Removed entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The conversion action. An outline at rest; the coral highlighter fills it on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:Poppins,Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:0.9375rem; line-height:1; padding:16px 24px; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; color:#141413; border:1px solid #141413; background-image:linear-gradient(#d97757,#d97757); background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:0 0; background-size:0% 100%; transition:background-size 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background-size:100% 100%; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a34a2a; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The lesser action. Same geometry, quieter fill, so the two never read as equals.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:Poppins,Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:0.9375rem; line-height:1; padding:16px 24px; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; color:#141413; border:1px solid #ded9cc; background-image:linear-gradient(#e8e6dc,#e8e6dc); background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:0 0; background-size:0% 100%; transition:background-size 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { background-size:100% 100%; }

components.name: Highlighter Mark
components.description: The signature. A coral band sweeps beneath a phrase over 150ms, marking each line separately when it wraps.
components.css: .ds-mark-wrap { font-family:Poppins,Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:2.5rem; line-height:1.04; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#141413; margin:0; } .ds-mark { background-image:linear-gradient(#d97757,#d97757); background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:0 88%; background-size:100% 0.42em; -webkit-box-decoration-break:clone; box-decoration-break:clone; transition:background-size 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Poppins 500. No underline at rest; the highlighter marks it on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family:Poppins,Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:0.9375rem; color:#141413; text-decoration:none; padding-bottom:2px; background-image:linear-gradient(#d97757,#d97757); background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:0 88%; background-size:0% 0.34em; transition:background-size 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background-size:100% 0.34em; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Oat on Warm Paper. Depth is tonal — this system has no shadows.
components.html:
What a semester looks like

Workshops, build nights, and a hackathon.
components.css: .ds-panel { background:#e8e6dc; border:1px solid #ded9cc; border-radius:8px; padding:32px; } .ds-panel h3 { font-family:Poppins,Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.5rem; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#141413; margin:0 0 8px; } .ds-panel p { font-family:Lora,Georgia,serif; font-size:1.0625rem; line-height:1.65; color:#686560; margin:0; max-width:68ch; }

narrative.overview: This is a printed page someone cared enough to mark up. The ground is warm paper, not screen-white. The reading voice is a serif. Headings are a geometric sans set tight and large, the way a well-set title page behaves. Nothing glows, nothing floats, nothing drifts into view on scroll. The one thing that moves is a coral highlighter, sweeping left to right beneath a phrase exactly once, the way a person marks a line they want to come back to. Restraint here is not minimalism for its own sake: the audience is a student who is not sure they are technical enough to belong, and a page that reads like a well-set document reads as an invitation.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#faf9f5), never pure white
Serif body, geometric-sans display — reading voice and title voice are distinct
Borders and tonal shifts instead of shadows; the system is flat
Sentence case everywhere; no eyebrows, no chips, no section numbers
Generous vertical space, body measure held to 65–75ch

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Claude Coral is a fill color and never sets type on paper. Measured, it is 2.96:1 against the paper ground, failing the 4.5:1 body threshold and the 3:1 large-text and non-text thresholds alike. Any coral word uses Burnt Terracotta (5.58:1 on paper, 4.70:1 on Oat).

rules.name: The No-Gray-Text-Above-Stone Rule
rules.body: Pale Clay is 2.11:1 on paper and is decorative. Secondary text stops at Stone Gray, which clears 4.5:1 on both paper and Oat.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Poppins titles, Lora prose. A block of Poppins running longer than two lines is a mistake; so is a heading set in Lora.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor
rules.body: Display and headline sizes carry negative tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em). Body text never does.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to feel separate, change its tone or give it a hairline. Reaching for box-shadow means the tonal step was not doing its job.

dos: Do use Burnt Terracotta (#a34a2a) for every coral word, and Claude Coral (#d97757) only as a fill.
Do hold body copy to the 68ch measure and leads to 46ch.
Do convey depth with tone — Oat on Warm Paper — and hairline rules.
Do keep the highlighter to its three sanctioned uses.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus ring (2px Burnt Terracotta, 3px offset).
Do write in sentence case, including headings and buttons.
donts: Don't substitute the warm-paper-plus-terracotta palette. A slop detector will flag it as an AI tell; on this project it is the client's actual brand and the finding is a known false positive.
Don't add a second animation. No scroll reveals, no fades, no parallax, no counters, no hover-lifts, no page transitions, no smooth scrolling.
Don't put an eyebrow, kicker, chip, or section number above a heading.
Don't set Pale Clay (#b0aea5) as text at any size.
Don't nest cards, or use same-size icon-plus-heading-plus-text cards as the page's structure.
Don't use emoji as an icon system. Icons are drawn SVG at one consistent stroke weight; the club's custom emoji set is the single sanctioned exception and only in the link hub.
Don't self-host Styrene, Tiempos, or Copernicus. They are licensed.
